{{Top|leg}}
The '''endosystem''' was a marketable feature found on [[TelBrinTel Corporation]]'s [[Science Research Droid]]. It provided six ports on the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] vertebrae for the attachment of dockable accessories. These accessories could include additional arms, work surfaces, or small tools or injection needles.
